def evaluate_state(state_view, player_id):
    board = state_view.board
    other = 1 - player_id
    own = board[player_id * 6:player_id * 6 + 6]
    opp = board[other * 6:other * 6 + 6]
    lead = state_view.captured[player_id] - state_view.captured[other]
    seeds = sum(own) - sum(opp)
    total = sum(own) + sum(opp)
    return max(-10.0, min(10.0, 0.7 * lead + 0.3 * seeds / (1 + total)))
